```text
  In the limiting light-speed case, the 5 light-year gap is crossed in 5 years.
    The birth you witness is 5 years in the past in the child's rest frame.
      During the crossing, the child ages another 5 years.
        So at arrival, the child is 10 years old from his own perspective.
```
